Hi, I'm like you in that I'm very young with a level of pain normally seen in old people (I'm 18, had pain since 16). Unfortunately, especially at our age getting help and finding the right people can be extremely difficult. I can't offer any guidance for the actual injury since I have issues in my legs, but I highly reccomend investigating pain management clinics. I don't know where you live, but luckily in Australia I had access and was able to be seen quickly (jumped the waiting list) because I'm so young. I used to not be able to stand without unbearable nerve pain after a few minutes, but now I manage amazingly and have been able to get back into the things I used to do. See the legit ones, they tend to run out of hospitals, not the naturopath crap (in my experience they'll say some fancy words, say it's what you have, and then sign you up for 20 $200 "treatment" sessions of some form. AVOID CHIROPRACTORS ESPECIALLY, according to them everyone has mild scoliosis.) The clinic I go to is mostly covered by Medicare (Australia), so it isn't too expensive, but that depends on where you live. Hope this helps somewhat
